_comment: Hand-verified ground truth for the 2026-10-23 Amherst Stadium U11 game. Every entry was checked by extracting the frame with `ffmpeg -ss <media> -i <clip> -frames:v 1` and viewing it. media = seconds into the recording (the segment's first frame is 0.0).

game.source: https://www.grayjay.app (Bluenose board data.json), the homegrown reader journal, and reviewed frames

transitions.note: home 1 at media 495 (clock 5:09), 2 at 496; board clock frozen at 5:09 for the stoppage
period 1 with 0.0 at media 1041, period 2 with 15:00 at 1042
the board clock reaches 0.0 at the end of P1 (media 1041, frame) and holds there through the intermission
P2's clock holds at 15:00 from media 1042 to 1141, then counts (14:59 at 1142, 14:58 at 1143); frames confirm the hold

20261023T091022.mkv.clock_stop_note: Derived from journal gaps where the clock moved <=1 s across >=6 s of media (the clock runs 1:1 elsewhere in the journal), and spot-checked on frames at 170, 240, 365, 470, 505, 615, 720, 795, 855, 1160, 1200, 1240, 1300, 1390, 1550, 1650 and 1750 s (all showing a standing clock). The 489-522 s span was merged across the 5:09 goal stoppage. The P2 clock holding at 15:00 from media 1042 to 1141 (frames at 1060, 1090, 1120, 1138: all 15:00; 14:59 at 1142) is a stop too, although the journal shows no poll there.

excluded_gaps.why: intermission: the board clock is blank, then counts down the warm-up (18.0 at media 1000)
clock moved 3 s across a 3 s gap: running
